fields.label: Source and theorem
fields.text: Spacetime/locality invariant of KLPR2022 Tables 1-3 (stage I in the intersection of the causal pasts of all Q_i; validation at Q_b without cross-checking). Not an epsilon bound.

fields.label: Assumptions
items: Secure synchronisation to a common frame (paper Discussion p.9)
Agents' classical channels secure and authenticated

fields.label: Numerical method
fields.text: property test of causal event ordering

fields.label: Caveats
items: Security of the token schemes does not rely on spacetime constraints (paper Discussion); the invariant is required only for the instant-validation advantage.
